newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA'S OTC MARKET KEEPS IN BULLISH MOOD.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA'S OTC MARKET KEEPS IN BULLISH MOOD.

text.p: Romanian shares traded on the local over-the-counter (OTC) market picked up on Monday in active trading, with investors focusing on oil refineries and cement makers.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, was 201.8 points up from the previous session at 3,771.1 points.
Traders said the bullish mood would continue to grip the market this week amid growing foreign interest.
"Foreign investors are the main players on the market at present and they set the mood," he added.
"Buying interest in oil refineries, cement makers and metallurgical sector stocks will remain strong," said a trader.
Arpechim oil refinery was one on the day's top gainers due to strong demand. It close 9,000 lei higher from the previous session at 45,000.
Operators said they expected prices of refineries shares to stabilise in the immediate future. "Refineries are expensive enough so I expect a downslide," a broker said.
Cement makers Moldocim, Romcim and Casial stayed at centre-stage.
Moldocim and Casial closed 3,500 and 400 lei higher at 42,500 and 2,100 respectively. Romcim was flat at 56,000.
The RASDAQ volume rose to 2.5 million shares from around 1.4 million last Friday, with turnover climbing to 12.3 billion lei from over 7.7 billion. ($=7,094 lei)
